explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 26 is near 1 at GO/D2 and varies mainly at D1, where it is lowered by the previous trial's outcome: lowest after a rewarded S2 visit (a1 S2 r -0.30, a2 S2 r -0.07), slightly low after unrewarded S2 via a1 (-0.09), and raised after S1 outcomes, most after unrewarded S1 (a1/a2 S1 u +0.11/+0.13, S1 r +0.04/+0.08). So D1 z tracks evidence that S2 is good (reward at S2 lowers, no reward at S1 raises), with an extra drop after rare a1->S2 rewards. The same 8-pattern shape is scaled by episode time: weight about 1.07 overall, +0.75 in trials 90-99, +0.36 in 80-89, -0.27 in trials 0-59, mirroring the timing baseline where D1 z falls from 0.89 to 0.55 late. Observed-only, no model outputs: dev 0.63, test R^2 beyond timing 0.60 vs the all-cue ceiling 0.64 and all-observed reference 0.60. Not helpful: trial-before reward, consecutive rewards, belief_lo at D1 (no gain); GO belief_lo / GO prev_reward add only ~0.002. Model policy deciles alone score 0.18 but add nothing beyond last-trial history, so dropping value/policy costs little (~0.04 below the ceiling that includes them).

issues: The D1 core checks out. The 4 claimed terms reproduce test R^2 beyond timing 0.6046 (weights 1.07 / +0.75 / +0.36 / -0.27). The 8-pattern shape alone scores 0.553, so the late-episode amplification is real and adds about 0.05.

The explanation wrongly says GO adds nothing. In the profile, the GO residual by belief decile runs monotonically from +0.016 (S2 sure) to -0.022 (S1 sure). The original misses also list GO after a1 S1 r (-0.028) and GO after a2 S1 u / a2 S2 u (+0.021 / +0.020) as the largest remaining systematic errors. Several worst-fit windows are late-episode a1 runs: GO actual is about 0.61-0.75 against a prediction of 0.89.

The claim that belief_lo at GO added only about 0.002 is false. Adding (phase==GO)*belief_lo alone raises test from 0.6046 to 0.620. GO*prev_action (a1 vs a2) alone gives 0.618, and with a late-episode interaction 0.629.

Three GO terms (a last-trial pattern at GO, plus prev_action x late and belief_lo x late at GO) bring test to 0.639. That is above the all-observed reference of 0.60 and at the all-cue ceiling of 0.64. So the reported fit is not at the observed-only limit, and there is no measured cost from dropping value/policy once GO is modelled.

Wrong reading of the D1 shape: 'tracks evidence that S2 is the good state' does not hold. Under model-based logic, a1 S1 u and a2 S1 u are evidence for S2 being good, yet they raise z the most (+0.11 / +0.13). a2 S2 u (evidence for S1) is +0.03 and a1 S2 u (evidence for S1) is -0.09. Belief deciles at D1 score only 0.03 and have a non-monotone residual. D1*(late)*belief_lo adds nothing (0.6037). The real pattern is the previous reached state x reward: S2, especially rewarded and especially rare a1->S2, lowers z; S1 raises it, more so when unrewarded. It is not inferred state value.
Smaller remaining errors after the fix, all <= 0.008: D1 after a2 S1 r -0.007, GO after a1 S1 u +0.008.
